name: Public informational menu read-service boundary
identifierOrigin: OWNER-DIRECTED POST-003E FORMALIZATION; no pre-existing FOOD-004A identifier claimed.
scope: Injected internal application read service for future public informational exposure. Consumes FOOD-002; neither supersedes it nor reopens FOOD-003. No HTTP/UI/activation.

contract.construction: Synchronous I/O-free factory captures callable getPublication/getPresentation/getOffer with their original receiver, plus existing FoodMenuReadDependencies product/recipe methods. Returned frozen object exposes readPublicMenu only; no auth/admin or persistence/runtime construction.
contract.selection: Strict exact {publicationId, version}, validated with existing ID/safe version parsers and captured before first await. No latest/current/list/fallback/cache policy. Future route selects exact live publication separately.
contract.outcomes: Frozen status-only invalid-input/not-found/not-published/unavailable, or found with only existing FoodPublicMenuProjection. Dependency failures, malformed envelopes, missing/mismatched exact dependencies, bound violations and projector failure map to unavailable without diagnostics.
contract.flow: Exact publication read; verify returned identity/version and explicit published state before downstream reads. Scan bounded canonical topology and deduplicate menu-level exact presentation/offer references. Resolve each distinct presentation, offer, product and recipe once per invocation; check every exact identity/version. Pass detached publication/contexts/offers and empty availability observations to projectFoodPublicMenu. Projector owns all deeper relationship validation and public allowlisting. No partial success.
contract.availability: FOOD-002C explicitly permits missing observations even when availability selection is true. No exact observation revisions are stored in publication selection. Supply [] to omit optional availability rather than invent latest/current selection or infer availability/orderability. A future observation-selection contract is separate.
contract.limits: At most 100 combined distinct exact presentation and offer references. Domain topology limits remain 20 sections/100 entries per section/20 offers per entry. Oversize rejects before downstream reads. Product/recipe counts are each bounded by distinct presentations, so total service calls <=301 including publication. Repository-internal validation reads are outside this service's injected-call count; no database transaction or global-cache claim.
contract.snapshotSafety: Immediately capture every resolved raw snapshot into detached frozen plain records before next await; reject cycles, non-data values and pathological snapshots using depth 20, 100000 nodes, 40000 array items. Projector provides final detached/frozen public output, so service does not duplicate public mapping/freezing.
contract.consistency: Sequential immutable exact-version reads; local per-invocation maps only, never cross-call caching. Exact product/recipe historical context retained; no publication scan or fallback.
contract.separation: Publication, public projection, service, HTTP route, UI, offer, approved price, cart and order remain distinct. Published/projectable does not mean orderable or deployed.

validationGates: Full FOOD suite including projector/persistence/private service/workspace
excluded: No raw/private records/capabilities/errors in output; no FOOD-003 nutrition/cost/prices/portions, price/orderability, routes/UI/configuration/migrations/real menu data, remote operations, deployment, staging, commit or push.
